abstract: This paper uses a structural gravity model to examine the partial equilibrium effects of the European Monetary Union (EMU) on trade for the agricultural sector. We find robust evidence that EMU has increased trade both between members and between EMU and non‐EMU member countries. This positive link is found in most member countries. Moreover, the overall impact of EMU on trade between members has not been different for late and early joiners. The year‐by‐year and period‐by‐period analyses show that the effect of EMU is increasing over time. In addition, we conduct a counterfactual general equilibrium experiment that reveals a remarkable welfare‐enhancing effect of EMU for its member countries.
abstract_zh: 本文运用结构引力模型，考察了欧洲货币联盟（EMU）对农业部门贸易的部分均衡效应。我们发现有力证据表明，EMU不仅促进了成员国之间的贸易，也增进了EMU与非成员国之间的贸易。这一正向关联在大多数成员国中均有所体现。此外，EMU对成员国间贸易的总体影响在后期加入国与早期加入国之间并无显著差异。逐年及逐期分析显示，EMU的效应随时间递增。进一步地，我们实施了一项反事实一般均衡实验，结果表明EMU为其成员国带来了显著的福利增进效应。
title: EMU and trade: The euro effect on the agricultural sector
title_zh: 欧洲经济货币联盟与贸易：欧元对农业部门的影响

abstract: Customers in over‐the‐counter (OTC) markets must find a counterparty to trade. Little is known about this process, however, because existing data consist of transaction records, which only reveal the outcome of a search. Using data from a trading platform for corporate bonds, we unpack the search process. We analyze how long it takes customers to trade and how dealers' offers evolve across repeated inquiries. We estimate that it takes two to three days to complete a transaction after an unsuccessful attempt, with substantial variation across trade and customer characteristics. Our analysis offers insights into the sources of trading delays in OTC markets.
abstract_zh: 在场外交易（OTC）市场中，客户必须寻找交易对手方。然而，由于现有数据仅包含交易记录，仅能揭示搜索的结果，因此对这一过程知之甚少。利用公司债券交易平台的数据，我们揭示了搜索过程。我们分析了客户完成交易所需的时间，以及交易商在多次询价中报价的演变情况。我们估计，在一次不成功的尝试后，完成一笔交易需要两到三天时间，且这一时长因交易和客户特征的不同而有显著差异。我们的分析为理解OTC市场交易延迟的根源提供了见解。
title: Sequential Search for Corporate Bonds
title_zh: 公司债券的序贯搜索

abstract: We study productivity disparities across metropolitan and non‐metropolitan areas in Great Britain. Spatial disparities in productivity are large and persistent. Using a development accounting framework, we show that differences in area size and in the spatial distribution of human and business capital are key explanatory factors. A combination of area size and human capital explains 30% of the productivity variance, increasing to 43–57% once we add measures of business capital stocks. Applying our framework to a case study of Greater Manchester, we show that large increases in both types of capital are needed to narrow productivity disparities with London, illustrating the scale of the challenge for policies aimed at reducing spatial inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了英国大都市与非大都市地区之间的生产率差异。空间上的生产率差异既大且持久。运用发展核算框架，我们表明区域规模以及人力资本和商业资本的空间分布差异是关键解释因素。区域规模与人力资本的结合解释了生产率变异的30%，而一旦加入商业资本存量指标，这一比例提升至43%至57%。将我们的框架应用于大曼彻斯特的案例研究，我们发现，要缩小与伦敦的生产率差距，需要大幅增加这两类资本，这凸显了旨在减少空间不平等的政策所面临的挑战规模。
title: Spatial productivity disparities in Great Britain
title_zh: 英国空间生产率差异研究

abstract: From an individual agent’s perspective, a deterministic strategyproof mechanism is characterized by an option set: it selects the agent’s most-preferred alternative from that set. This paper develops a stochastic generalization of option sets. To this end, we focus on what we call single-agent mechanisms, which capture the perspective of a single agent. We show that a stochastic dominance strategyproof (sd-strategyproof) single-agent mechanism can be represented by a normalized, scaled, nondecreasing, and submodular set function defined on subsets of alternatives, and conversely. Through duality, this representation establishes a one-to-one correspondence between sd-strategyproof single-agent mechanisms and nondecreasing convex games with grand-coalition value one. We also observe that option sets, viewed as set functions, are dual to unanimity games. Consequently, every sd-strategyproof single-agent mechanism can be expressed as a linear combination of deterministic strategyproof single-agent mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 从单个代理人的视角来看，一个确定性策略proof机制的特征在于一个选项集合：它从该集合中选择代理人最偏好的备选方案。本文发展了选项集合的随机推广。为此，我们聚焦于所谓的单代理人机制，该机制捕捉了单个代理人的视角。我们证明，一个随机占优策略proof（sd-strategyproof）的单代理人机制可以由定义在备选方案子集上的一个归一化、缩放、非递减且子模的集合函数来表示，反之亦然。通过对偶性，这一表示建立了sd-strategyproof单代理人机制与具有大联盟值为一的非递减凸博弈之间的一一对应关系。我们还观察到，选项集合作为集合函数，与一致博弈是对偶的。因此，每个sd-strategyproof单代理人机制都可以表示为确定性策略proof单代理人机制的线性组合。
title: Stochastic dominance strategyproofness and submodularity
title_zh: 随机占优策略无懈可击性与次模性

abstract: We study the strong core of housing markets when agents’ preferences over houses are expressed as partial orders. We provide a structural characterization of the strong core, and propose an efficient algorithm that finds an allocation in the strong core or decides that it is empty, even in the presence of forced and forbidden arcs. The algorithm satisfies the property of weak group-strategyproofness. Additionally, we show that certain results known for the strong core in the case where agents’ preferences are weak orders can be extended to the setting with partial order preferences; among others, we show that the strong core in such housing markets satisfies the property of respecting improvements.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人对房屋的偏好以偏序形式表达时住房市场的强核。我们提供了强核的结构性特征，并提出了一种高效算法，该算法能在存在强制弧和禁止弧的情况下找到强核中的分配或判定其为空。该算法满足弱群体策略证明性。此外，我们证明，在代理人偏好为弱序的情况下已知的关于强核的某些结果可以扩展到偏序偏好设置中；其中，我们证明此类住房市场中的强核满足尊重改进的性质。
title: The strong core of housing markets with partial order preferences
title_zh: 具有偏序偏好的住房市场的强核

abstract: Increasing attention is being paid to the design of economic incentives for conservation on private land to encourage spatial coordination. We investigate the effects of using incorrect information on the ecological benefits of spatial coordination in the design of a conservation auction, using a framed field experiment with real farmers as participants. We find that auction performance can be substantially weakened if the parameters adopted are ‘wrong enough’ to change which farms are prioritized for enrolment in a conservation contract. Parameters that under-estimate the true coordination benefits are less damaging to policy performance than those which over-estimate these benefits.
abstract_zh: 私人土地保护的经济激励设计正日益受到关注，以促进空间协调。我们通过一项以真实农民为参与者的框架实地实验，研究了在保护拍卖设计中采用关于空间协调生态效益的错误信息所产生的影响。研究发现，如果采用的参数“错误程度足够大”，以至于改变了保护合同优先纳入的农场排序，拍卖绩效可能会显著削弱。低估真实协调效益的参数对政策绩效的损害小于高估这些效益的参数。
title: Spatially coordinated conservation auctions under imperfect information about ecological spillovers
title_zh: 不完全信息下考虑生态溢出效应的空间协调保护拍卖

abstract: We analyse how agricultural extension services affect farm resilience using the Post-Russian Invasion Survey of Smallholder Farmers in Ukraine for 2022–3. Farm household resilience is measured using the Resilience Capacity Index (RCI), constructed from Adaptive Capacity (AC), Assets (AST), Social Safety Nets (SSN), and Sensitivity (S). To address the heterogeneity problem, Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) defines homogenous resilience profiles. The manuscript also examines a causal relationship by incorporating treatment effects into latent analysis. The results reveal that extension service receivers experience higher levels of AST and SSN. The extension service has a positive effect on RCI levels.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2022-2023年乌克兰小农户战后入侵调查数据，分析农业推广服务如何影响农场韧性。农场家庭韧性通过韧性能力指数（RCI）衡量，该指数由适应能力（AC）、资产（AST）、社会安全网（SSN）和敏感性（S）构成。为应对异质性问题，采用潜在剖面分析（LPA）定义同质韧性剖面。本文还通过将处理效应纳入潜在分析，考察因果关系。结果显示，接受推广服务的农户在AST和SSN方面水平更高。推广服务对RCI水平具有正向影响。
title: Agricultural extension services for farm resilience in Russian–Ukrainian Conflict
title_zh: 俄乌冲突背景下农业推广服务对农场韧性的作用

abstract: Despite an overwhelming scientific consensus about the adverse effects of climate change and potential adaptation strategies, the uptake rates of climate adaptation practices fall short of expectations and public perceptions about the drivers and implications of climate change remain mixed. This paper examines whether farmers’ psychological traits, particularly locus of control, predict climate adaptation strategies. We focus on adoption of drought-tolerant varieties, fast-maturing varieties, early/late planting varieties, crop diversification, conservation agriculture, and water harvesting technologies using a large household survey from Ethiopia. We also explore climate change perceptions, and whether and how they align with actual climatic records. We find that farmers with a higher degree of internal locus of control are more likely to adopt various climate adaptation practices and are more likely to perceive changes in mean precipitation and temperature, while those with a higher level of external locus of control are less likely to perceive climate change and hence less likely to adopt climate-resilient practices. One standard deviation increase in internal (external) locus of control is associated with 3–5 percentage points higher (lower) probability of adopting alternative climate adaptation practices. We also find suggestive evidence that farmers’ climate adaptation responses are consistent with their climate perceptions and actual climatic records. These findings highlight the important role of behavioral attributes, including psychological traits, in explaining climate perceptions and subsequent climate actions.
abstract_zh: 尽管科学界对气候变化的不利影响及潜在适应策略已形成压倒性共识，但气候适应实践的采纳率仍低于预期，且公众对气候变化的驱动因素及其影响的认识依然存在分歧。本文旨在探讨农民的心理特质，特别是控制点，是否能预测其气候适应策略。我们利用埃塞俄比亚的一项大规模农户调查，聚焦于抗旱品种、早熟品种、早播/晚播品种的采用，作物多样化、保护性农业及集水技术的采纳情况。同时，我们还考察了农民对气候变化的认知，以及这些认知是否及如何与实际气候记录相吻合。研究发现，内控倾向较强的农民更可能采纳多种气候适应实践，并更倾向于感知到平均降水量和温度的变化；而外控倾向较强的农民则较少感知到气候变化，因此采纳气候韧性实践的可能性较低。内控（外控）水平每增加一个标准差，采纳替代性气候适应实践的概率相应提高（降低）3至5个百分点。我们还发现了初步证据表明，农民的气候适应行为与其气候认知及实际气候记录相一致。这些发现强调了行为属性（包括心理特质）在解释气候认知及后续气候行动中的重要作用。
title: Locus of control, climate change adaptation and perception: Evidence from rural Ethiopia
title_zh: 控制点、气候变化适应与感知：来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据

abstract: This paper considers equilibrium trade in a real estate market. When search is directed, buyers have private independent values, and sellers compete on asking prices, stock-flow matching characterises equilibrium outcomes. Consistent with the data, equilibrium not only generates large and variable price spikes for new listing sales; unsuccessful sellers lower their asking prices over time; and there is equilibrium asking price dispersion. Bidding war data demonstrate that the match surplus is substantial: a lower bound equals 3.3% of house price, whereas ballpark examples suggest match surplus is around 10%.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了房地产市场中的均衡交易。在定向搜索条件下，买方拥有私人独立价值，卖方在要价上竞争，存量-流量匹配刻画了均衡结果。与数据一致，均衡不仅导致新挂牌销售出现大幅且多变的房价飙升；未成功售出的卖方会随时间降低要价；且存在均衡要价离散现象。竞价战数据表明，匹配剩余相当可观：其下限相当于房价的3.3%，而粗略估算示例则显示匹配剩余约为10%。
title: Bidding wars in the housing market: When directed search becomes stock-flow matching
title_zh: 住房市场中的竞价战：当定向搜索变为存量-流量匹配时

abstract: Lithium, cobalt, nickel, copper, and rare earth elements are reshaping global trade and great-power politics in ways reminiscent of the earlier scramble for natural resources. This column argues that the familiar resource-curse mechanisms still bite, but do so in a rather difference context characterised by a supply chain that is bifurcated between scattered extraction and Chinese-concentrated refining, global demand that is exposed to rapid within-class technological substitution, and the absence of a multilateral architecture comparable to the one that disciplined the oil age. This creates genuine Knightian uncertainty and emphasises the importance of smart contract design, appropriate fiscal policy – particularly on taxation – and the governance of supply chains.
abstract_zh: 锂、钴、镍、铜及稀土元素正重塑全球贸易与大国外交格局，其态势令人回想起早期对自然资源的争夺。本文认为，熟悉的资源诅咒机制依然发挥作用，但其所处的背景已大不相同：供应链呈现分散开采与中国集中精炼的双轨结构，全球需求面临同类技术快速替代的冲击，且缺乏类似约束石油时代的多边治理架构。这构成了真正的奈特式不确定性，凸显了智能合约设计、恰当的财政政策（尤其是税收政策）以及供应链治理的重要性。
authors: Christopher Adam, Rabah Arezki, Frederick van der Ploeg
china_relevance_reason: 论文主题为全球关键矿产竞争与资源诅咒，中国仅作为供应链背景提及，非核心研究对象。
title: The scramble for critical minerals: An old curse in a new world
title_zh: 关键矿产的争夺：新世界中的旧诅咒

abstract: Discussions on Japan’s ‘lost decades’ have long focused on sluggish demand and the survival of ‘zombie’ firms. However, new evidence from microdata suggests a fundamental shift. This column argues that Japan’s productivity dynamics are moving from internal firm improvements to market-driven reallocation and reveals that the country’s unique ‘negative exit effect’ is largely driven by the mergers and acquisitions activity of high-productivity firms.
abstract_zh: 关于日本“失去的几十年”的讨论，长期以来聚焦于需求疲软和“僵尸”企业的存续。然而，来自微观数据的新证据表明，情况发生了根本性转变。本专栏认为，日本的生产率动态正从企业内部改进转向市场驱动的重新配置，并揭示该国独特的“负退出效应”在很大程度上是由高生产率企业的并购活动所驱动的。
authors: Kyoji Fukao, YoungGak Kim, Hyeog Ug Kwon
title: Japan’s productivity transformation: From within-firm stagnation to market-driven reallocation
title_zh: 日本生产率转型：从企业内部停滞到市场驱动的再配置

abstract: Does matching loan repayments to expected cash flows raise take-up and the welfare impact of microcredit? We test this in a randomized controlled trial with Morocco`s largest microfinance institution. The experiment introduces two new individual-liability loan products: a contract with a five-month principal grace period and a tailored contract with installments matched to expected revenues. Over 3,000 applicants are randomly assigned to an offer of one of the two new contracts or the standard loan. The new contracts attract distinct borrowers: agricultural households take up the grace-period loan, while entrepreneurs operating smaller, more capital-constrained businesses choose the tailored schedule. Most tailored-loan borrowers front-load their repayments, suggesting that demand for flexibility reflects cost minimization, not only liquidity management. The tailored loan raises sales and profits via non-agricultural business expansion and labor reallocation to self-employment. The grace-period loan shows similar but statistically insignificant effects. Neither product worsens repayment performance. We find no effects on investment or consumption. In a second stage, we randomize contract-specific information campaigns across 440 villages. Despite shifting stated preferences toward the advertised products, the campaigns do not raise take-up, consistent with supply-side frictions and a challenging macroeconomic environment.
abstract_zh: 将贷款还款与预期现金流相匹配是否能提高小额信贷的采纳率及其福利影响？我们通过与摩洛哥最大的小额信贷机构进行随机对照试验来检验这一问题。实验中引入了两种新的个人责任贷款产品：一种包含五个月本金宽限期的合同，以及一种还款计划与预期收入相匹配的定制合同。超过3000名申请者被随机分配至两种新合同之一或标准贷款的报价中。新合同吸引了不同类型的借款人：农业家庭选择宽限期贷款，而经营规模较小、资本受限企业的创业者则倾向于定制还款计划。大多数定制贷款借款者选择提前还款，这表明对灵活性的需求反映了成本最小化，而不仅仅是流动性管理。定制贷款通过非农业业务扩张和劳动力向自雇就业的重新配置，提高了销售额和利润。宽限期贷款显示出相似但统计上不显著的效果。两种产品均未恶化还款表现。我们未发现对投资或消费的影响。在第二阶段，我们在440个村庄中随机分配了针对特定合同的信息宣传活动。尽管这些活动将陈述偏好转向了广告宣传的产品，但并未提高采纳率，这与供给侧摩擦及充满挑战的宏观经济环境相一致。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为摩洛哥最大小额信贷机构及其借款人，数据与制度背景均非中国，与中国研究无关。
title: Microcredit Made to Measure: Experimental Evidence from Rural Morocco
title_zh: 量身定制的微型信贷：来自摩洛哥农村的实验证据

abstract: We examine the role of central bank reserves and public liquidity when secondary markets may freeze. Central bank reserves help intermediaries purchase assets during stress but crowd out investment. Under laissez-faire, intermediaries hold insufficient reserves, overlooking how aggregate liquidity reduces freeze risk. We propose a ``market-backstop principle", akin to Bagehot’s principle for intermediaries. It combines state-contingent buyer-of-last-resort interventions to restore trading with modest liquidity requirements to limit moral hazard. The welfare benefits of restoring market functioning exceed the fiscal costs of interventions. We explore implications for the size and composition of central bank balance sheets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在二级市场可能冻结时，中央银行储备和公共流动性的作用。中央银行储备有助于中介机构在压力时期购买资产，但会挤出投资。在自由放任政策下，中介机构持有的储备不足，忽视了总体流动性降低冻结风险的作用。我们提出了一项“市场后盾原则”，类似于针对中介机构的巴杰特原则。该原则结合了状态依存的最后买家干预措施以恢复交易，并辅以适度的流动性要求以限制道德风险。恢复市场运作的福利收益超过了干预的财政成本。我们探讨了这对中央银行资产负债表规模和构成的影响。
title: Reserves and the Buyer of Last Resort
title_zh: 储备与最后买家

abstract: We analyze the conflict of interest that arises when universal banks engage in proprietary trading of borrower stocks, which has been a prominent concern in the regulatory debates for a long time. We combine trade-by-trade supervisory data with credit registry information in Germany. Our findings reveal that lending relationships inform banks’ prop trading. To separate bank expertise and private information from lending as explanations, we study prop trading around corporate events. We show that banks execute purchases (sales) in borrower stocks in the weeks before positive (negative) news events, even when these events are unscheduled and surprising to the market. We link this trading pattern to situations when banks possess private borrower information, and rule out that it is explained by specialized expertise. We also find evidence consistent with information flows through banks’ centralized risk management, that banks alter trading patterns once they acquire private information, consistent with shrouding of informed trading, and that OTC counter-parties price-protect against relationship banks. Our evidence highlights the difficulty of avoiding conflicts in universal banking.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了全能银行在从事借款方股票自营交易时产生的利益冲突问题，这一直是监管讨论中的突出关切。我们将逐笔交易监管数据与德国信用登记信息相结合。研究结果显示，贷款关系为银行的自营交易提供了信息。为区分银行的专业知识与私人信息作为解释因素，我们围绕公司事件研究了自营交易行为。我们表明，在正面（负面）新闻事件发生前的数周内，银行会执行对借款方股票的买入（卖出）操作，即使这些事件是未安排的且对市场而言出乎意料。我们将这种交易模式与银行掌握借款方私人信息的情形联系起来，并排除了其由专业知识解释的可能性。我们还发现了与信息通过银行集中风险管理流动相一致的证据，即银行一旦获取私人信息便会改变交易模式，这与知情交易被掩盖的现象相符，并且场外交易对手方会对关系银行采取价格保护措施。我们的证据凸显了在全能银行中避免利益冲突的难度。
title: Conﬂicts of Interest in Banks: Evidence from Proprietary Trading
title_zh: 银行利益冲突：来自自营交易的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the role of resolvability as a new regulatory constraint for restricting bank behaviour. Using a regression-discontinuity design, we exploit the 2019 regulatory shock that made banks with assets below the $250 billion asset threshold exempt to mandatory resolution-planning (living will) requirements. We find that affected banks experience an increase in their profitability and their complexity. They also lend more and at more favorable terms. Credit granting is boosted especially in less resolvable loans with no covenant restrictions and in countries with poor creditor rights. Our findings suggest that by enforcing crisis plans, resolution requirements may contract credit supply.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了可处置性作为一项新的监管约束在限制银行行为中的作用。利用断点回归设计，我们借助2019年的监管冲击，该冲击使得资产低于2500亿美元门槛的银行免于强制性处置规划（生前遗嘱）要求。我们发现，受影响的银行盈利能力与复杂性有所提升，同时贷款发放增加且条件更为优惠。信贷投放尤其在不含契约限制、可处置性较低的贷款以及债权人权利保护较弱的国家中得到显著增强。我们的研究结果表明，通过强制实施危机计划，处置要求可能会收缩信贷供给。
title: Strong Wills, Strong Outcomes? Bank Resolvability and Credit Supply
title_zh: 坚强的意志，强劲的成效？银行可处置性与信贷供给

abstract: Do bettors misperceive expected returns, and does bringing their beliefs closer to the regulatory benchmark change betting and financial allocation decisions? Using a survey experiment in Brazil, we document that bettors are motivated by financial gain and entertainment and expect to receive approximately R$1.75 for every R$1 wagered, far above the R$0.85 regulatory benchmark. A randomized information treatment lowers bettors’ reported beliefs about expected returns by 28% to 37% but reduces the share of windfall income allocated to betting by only 2.1 percentage points. The treatment has a larger effect on the probability of allocating any money to betting than on the amount allocated among those who continue to bet. A parsimonious model rationalizes these findings: when betting provides substantial direct utility, more accurate beliefs have limited effects on betting expenditure and saving. Still, reducing overconfidence limits expected wealth losses, because overconfident bettors consume more today in anticipation of betting winnings that do not materialize on average. Information disclosure may therefore make beliefs more accurate without substantially reducing betting expenditure.
abstract_zh: 投注者是否误解了预期回报，而将他们的信念调整至更接近监管基准是否会改变其投注及财务分配决策？通过在巴西进行的一项调查实验，我们发现投注者既受财务收益也受娱乐动机驱动，他们预期每投注1雷亚尔能获得约1.75雷亚尔的回报，远高于0.85雷亚尔的监管基准。一项随机信息干预使投注者对预期回报的报告信念降低了28%至37%，但仅将意外之财收入中用于投注的比例减少了2.1个百分点。该干预对是否将任何资金用于投注的概率影响大于对继续投注者投注金额的影响。一个简约模型合理化了这些发现：当投注提供大量直接效用时，更准确的信念对投注支出和储蓄的影响有限。尽管如此，减少过度自信限制了预期财富损失，因为过度自信的投注者预期到平均而言不会实现的投注收益，从而在当前消费更多。因此，信息披露可能使信念更加准确，而不会大幅减少投注支出。
title: Overconfidence and Financial Behavior in Online Betting Markets
title_zh: 在线博彩市场中的过度自信与金融行为

abstract: Financial markets are highly differentiated: firms issue many products beyond stocks and bonds. This variety is consequential because the products firms use determine which issuers raise capital, on what terms, and which risks investors absorb. We propose a model of variety and firms’ allocation across products. Products repackage firms’ cash flows and differ in expected payoff per unit of exposure to aggregate risk and firm-specific risk passed to investors. Aggregate exposure raises the compensation all issuers must offer, whereas firm-specific risk lowers only the issuing firm’s payoff. We show that specialized products coexist with widely adopted ones through trade-offs between these two dimensions.
abstract_zh: 金融市场高度分化：企业发行的产品远不止股票和债券。这种多样性意义重大，因为企业所使用的产品决定了哪些发行者能筹集资本、以何种条件筹集，以及投资者承担哪些风险。我们提出了一个关于产品多样性及企业跨产品配置的模型。产品重新组合企业的现金流，并在传递给投资者的总体风险和企业特定风险的单位暴露预期回报上存在差异。总体暴露提高了所有发行者必须提供的补偿，而企业特定风险仅降低发行企业自身的回报。我们证明，专业化产品与广泛采用的产品通过这两个维度之间的权衡而共存。
title: Variety and Agglomeration in Financial Markets
title_zh: 金融市场的多样性与集聚

abstract: This article examines the impact of high temperatures on the downstream enterprises. By constructing ‘supplier-customer’ pairs during 2001–2022, this article explores exogenous variation in temperature and finds that high temperatures in suppliers’ regions significantly reduce customers’ performance. The effects are more pronounced for non-state-owned, smaller, less digitalized, more supply-chain-concentrated and less monopolistic enterprises. The possible channel is that suppliers pass on the increased costs due to high temperatures to customers, leading to adverse impacts on their performance. The study enriches the research on extreme weather and provides insights about how to respond to supply chain risks in a warming world. KEYWORDS: Extreme high temperatures supply chain risks enterprise performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q54 L25 G30
abstract_zh: 本文考察了高温对下游企业的影响。通过构建2001—2022年间的“供应商—客户”配对，本文利用温度的外生变化发现，供应商所在地区的高温显著降低了客户的绩效。这一效应在非国有企业、规模较小、数字化程度较低、供应链集中度较高以及垄断程度较低的企业中更为明显。可能的传导渠道是，供应商将高温导致的成本增加转嫁给客户，从而对其绩效产生不利影响。本研究丰富了极端天气相关研究，并为在变暖世界中如何应对供应链风险提供了启示。关键词：极端高温 供应链风险 企业绩效 JEL分类：Q54 L25 G30

abstract: This article examines meat consumption behaviour across four meat categories (pork, beef, poultry and lamb) in urban and rural China through a dynamic demand system that accounts for habit formation and pre-committed effects. Based on provincial‑level data spanning the period 2015 to 2022, estimation results show that all categories are habitual, with beef being the most habitual and rural consumers displaying stronger habit formation. A higher level of pre-committed consumption is observed for pork relative to other categories, indicating that pork retains its position as a dietary staple among Chinese consumers, while pre-committed consumption for poultry is negative, reflecting its flexible and price-responsive role in household meat budgets. Demographic variables, including population growth and family size, are shown to significantly shape meat demand in urban areas, while ageing plays an important role in all four meat categories among rural consumers. Long-term elasticity prediction suggests that beef and poultry are likely to take a larger portion of future meat expenditure. Our findings provide empirical support for policymakers and industry stakeholders regarding future meat consumption, showing poultry can serve as a cost-effective substitute for pork and other red meats, while emphasizing the need to improve the supply chain resilience of beef production in China. abstract_zh: 本文通过一个考虑习惯形成和预先承诺效应的动态需求系统，考察了中国城镇和农村地区四类肉类（猪肉、牛肉、禽肉和羊肉）的消费行为。基于2015年至2022年的省级面板数据，估计结果显示所有肉类类别均具有习惯形成特征，其中牛肉的习惯形成最为显著，且农村消费者的习惯形成更强。与其它肉类类别相比，猪肉的预先承诺消费水平较高，表明猪肉在中国消费者饮食结构中仍保持主食地位，而禽肉的预先承诺消费为负值，反映出其在家庭肉类预算中具有灵活且价格敏感的作用。人口统计变量，包括人口增长和家庭规模，显著影响城镇地区的肉类需求，而老龄化对农村消费者所有四类肉类的需求均具有重要作用。长期弹性预测表明，牛肉和禽肉在未来肉类消费支出中所占比重可能更大。我们的研究结果为政策制定者和行业相关方提供了关于未来肉类消费的实证支持，表明禽肉可作为猪肉及其它红肉的经济有效替代品，同时强调提升中国牛肉生产供应链韧性的必要性。关键词：肉类消费 习惯形成 预先承诺效应 消费者行为 动态AIDS方法 JEL分类：Q11 Q18 D11 D12 Q10 致谢：感谢堪萨斯州立大学的Allen Featherstone、Edward Perry、Glynn Tonsor、Yangming Chang，亚利桑那州立大学的Justin Bina，肯塔基大学的Yuqing Zheng，佐治亚大学的Chen Zhen，以及密歇根州立大学的Jaime Luke提供的宝贵反馈和指导。

abstract: This paper assesses differences in countries' macroeconomic exposure to trade fragmentation along geopolitical lines. Estimating structural gravity regressions for sector‐level bilateral trade flows between 185 countries, we find that closer geopolitical ties are associated with lower barriers to trade, with the largest effects concentrated in a few sectors (notably, food and high‐end manufacturing). Consequently, countries' exposure via trade to geopolitical shifts varies with their market size, comparative advantage and foreign policy alignments. Introducing our estimates into a dynamic many‐country, many‐sector quantitative trade model, we show that geoeconomic fragmentation—modelled as an increased sensitivity of trade costs to geopolitics and greater geopolitical polarization—generally leads to lower trade and incomes. However, emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs) tend to see the largest impacts: real per‐capita income losses for the median EMDE in Asia are 80% larger, and 120% larger for the median EMDE in Africa, than for the median advanced economy. This suggests that the costs of trade fragmentation could fall disproportionally on countries that can afford it the least.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了各国在宏观经济层面对地缘政治贸易碎片化的暴露程度差异。通过估计涵盖185个国家部门级双边贸易流量的结构引力回归模型，我们发现更紧密的地缘政治联系与更低的贸易壁垒相关联，且最大效应集中在少数几个部门（尤其是食品和高科技制造业）。因此，各国通过贸易对地缘政治变动的暴露程度因其市场规模、比较优势及外交政策取向而异。将我们的估计引入一个动态的多国、多部门量化贸易模型后，我们表明，地缘经济碎片化——建模为贸易成本对地缘政治敏感性的增强及地缘政治极化程度的加深——通常会导致贸易和收入下降。然而，新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）往往受到最大影响：亚洲EMDEs中位数的实际人均收入损失比发达经济体中位数高出80%，非洲EMDEs中位数则高出120%。这表明，贸易碎片化的成本可能不成比例地落在最无力承担的国家身上。
title: Divided we fall: Differential exposure to geopolitical fragmentation in trade
title_zh: 分裂即衰：贸易中地缘政治碎片化的差异化暴露

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between economic conditions and incarceration in the postbellum United States. Leveraging unique administrative prison records in Missouri from 1850 to 1931 and the differential exposure to national agricultural price changes across counties, I find that positive economic shocks reduce prison admission rates for all crime categories, and negative shocks increase prison admission rates, with the relationship being larger for negative shocks. Although racial disparities in incarceration emerged after Reconstruction, with Black prison admission rates five times higher than white rates, I find no evidence that economic conditions affected prison admission rates differently across racial groups.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国内战后期经济状况与监禁之间的关系。利用密苏里州1850年至1931年间独特的行政监狱记录，以及各县对全国农产品价格变动的不同暴露程度，我发现正向经济冲击降低了所有犯罪类别的入狱率，而负向经济冲击则提高了入狱率，且负向冲击的影响更大。尽管重建时期后监禁中的种族差异显现，黑人入狱率是白人的五倍，但我未发现经济状况对不同种族群体的入狱率有差异化影响的证据。
title: Economic Conditions and Incarceration in the United States: Evidence from Missouri, 1850–1930
title_zh: 美国经济状况与监禁：来自密苏里州1850—1930年的证据

abstract: This paper studies the role of global banks as a source of shocks to global liquidity. Shifts in global liquidity can drive cross-border flows, asset prices, and exchange rates, with implications for financial stability. While the existing literature emphasizes global banks as amplifiers of global shocks, I provide causal evidence that idiosyncratic leverage shocks to these institutions loosen global liquidity conditions. The analysis exploits the high concentration of global banking to construct a Granular Instrumental Variable from the size-weighted sum of bank-level idiosyncratic leverage shocks. These shocks are estimated using Instrumented Principal Component Analysis, using observable bank characteristics (e.g., size, profitability, liquidity, and risk metrics) as instruments to account for bank-specific and time-varying exposures to common global factors. Using the instrument and panel local projections, I estimate the dynamic causal effects of these banks’ leverage shocks on key global liquidity measures for an unbalanced panel of 74 advanced and emerging market economies from 2000Q1 to 2022Q4. Positive shocks to global banks’ leverage significantly appreciate exchange rates against the dollar, reduce US dollar-denominated bond spreads, and increase gross cross-border inflows. Significant effects on total cross-border flows indicate broader spillovers across asset markets. These findings underscore the systemic relevance of G-SIBs in driving global financial conditions and support macro-financial models where financial intermediaries’ leverage is a key state variable influencing risk-taking and asset prices. By showing that global banks can originate, rather than merely transmit, global shocks, this paper adds to the literature on the global financial cycle and the international transmission of financial conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了全球银行作为全球流动性冲击来源的作用。全球流动性的变化能够驱动跨境资本流动、资产价格及汇率变动，并对金融稳定产生影响。尽管现有文献强调全球银行是放大全球冲击的渠道，本文提供了因果证据，表明这些机构特有的杠杆冲击会放宽全球流动性条件。分析利用全球银行业的高度集中性，通过银行层面特有杠杆冲击的规模加权总和构建了一个粒度工具变量。这些冲击采用工具变量主成分分析法进行估计，利用可观测的银行特征（如规模、盈利能力、流动性和风险指标）作为工具，以考虑银行特定及随时间变化的对共同全球因素的暴露。结合该工具与面板局部投影法，本文估算了2000年第一季度至2022年第四季度期间，74个发达经济体和新兴市场经济体组成的不平衡面板中，这些银行杠杆冲击对关键全球流动性指标的动态因果效应。全球银行杠杆的正向冲击显著使汇率对美元升值，降低美元计价债券利差，并增加总跨境流入。对总跨境流动的显著影响表明，冲击在资产市场间存在更广泛的溢出效应。这些发现强调了全球系统重要性银行在驱动全球金融状况中的系统性重要性，并支持金融中介杠杆作为影响风险承担和资产价格的关键状态变量的宏观金融模型。通过证明全球银行能够引发而非仅仅传导全球冲击，本文为全球金融周期及金融状况国际传导的相关文献做出了贡献。

title: Global Banks’ Leverage and Global Liquidity
